steps: 1. Open Mod Tweaker > General > Cheats and Debug > Time Controls. Assign **Freeze world toggle** and **Normal speed** to unused keys, press **Apply**, and close the menu.
2. In the Keep, stand on level ground near a wall. Use the freeze key. Walk forward/back/sideways, look around, and walk into the wall.
3. Resume with the freeze key. Repeat twice. Try a slope, then verify normal movement after resuming.

4. In a solo mission, freeze with a visible enemy. In separate attempts, freeze an already-moving physics prop or ragdoll and an airborne projectile. Check that each stops while you can walk/look, then resumes normally. Record any control you could not set up rather than treating it as passed.
5. While frozen, open Mod Tweaker, then use the **Normal speed** key. Close and reopen the menu: confirm **Freeze world** is off and normal movement/gameplay returns.
6. Freeze again, then disable Tweaker: General through the mod controls while still frozen. Confirm normal world progression returns. Re-enable it and confirm it does not start frozen.
assertions: non-player world progression stops, collision prevents walking through walls, and resume restores normal gameplay. This inspection driver keeps the player's pose/actions/jumping paused; do not expect combat or jump/dodge while frozen. Unsupported-state and late-join checks are separate follow-ups, not passes inferred from this solo card.
Harness: toggle freeze; world paused flag true and AI unit positions constant for 2 s; scripted move input changes player position; resume restores; issue1801_world_freeze_owner PASS.
